# Player statistics: track, drawdown, tendency, category, kNN and k-means.

# A track built from a vector of wagers / wins (one play every `gap` seconds).
make_track <- function(wager, win, cat = "classic", gap = 5, start = 1e6, risky = FALSE) {
  tk <- track_new(0)
  bal <- start
  cat <- rep_len(cat, length(wager)); risky <- rep_len(risky, length(wager))
  for (i in seq_along(wager)) {
    bal <- bal - wager[i] + win[i]
    tk <- track_add(tk, i * gap, bal, wager[i], win[i], cat[i], risky[i])
  }
  tk
}

test_that("the track keeps a bounded ring buffer and lifetime aggregates", {
  n <- STAT_TRACK_CAP + 40
  tk <- make_track(rep(100, n), rep(c(0, 150), length.out = n), cat = c("classic", "poker"))
  expect_equal(tk$n, n)
  expect_length(tk$bal, STAT_TRACK_CAP)
  expect_length(tk$cat, STAT_TRACK_CAP)
  expect_equal(sum(tk$wager_cat), 100 * n)
  expect_equal(tk$plays_cat[["classic"]], n / 2)
  expect_equal(tk$active, STAT_PLAY_SECS + 5 * (n - 1))        # first play after "idle", then 5 s gaps
})

test_that("idle gaps do not count as play time", {
  tk <- track_new(0)
  tk <- track_add(tk, 100, 1e6, 100, 0, "classic")
  tk <- track_add(tk, 110, 1e6, 100, 0, "classic")
  tk <- track_add(tk, 5000, 1e6, 100, 0, "classic")              # came back after 80 minutes
  expect_equal(tk$active, STAT_PLAY_SECS + 10 + STAT_PLAY_SECS)
})

test_that("maximum drawdown is the largest peak-to-trough fall", {
  # balance: 1000 -> 1500 (peak) -> 900 (trough) -> 1400 -> 1200
  wager <- c(0, 600, 0, 200); win <- c(500, 0, 500, 0)
  tk <- make_track(wager, win, start = 1000)
  expect_equal(tk$bal, c(1500, 900, 1400, 1200))
  expect_equal(tk$peak, 1500)
  expect_equal(tk$max_dd, 600)
  expect_equal(tk$max_dd_pct, 600 / 1500)
  ds <- drawdown_series(c(10, 12, 8, 15, 9))
  expect_equal(ds$peak, c(10, 12, 12, 15, 15))
  expect_equal(ds$dd, c(0, 0, 4, 0, 6))
  expect_equal(max(ds$dd), 6)
})

test_that("the starting balance counts as a peak (losing from the first play)", {
  tk <- make_track(rep(1000, 10), rep(0, 10), start = 1e6)
  expect_equal(tk$peak, 1e6)
  expect_equal(tk$max_dd, 10000)
})

test_that("tendency detects rising / falling balances, bet trends and loss chasing", {
  up <- make_track(rep(100, 60), rep(300, 60), start = 1e5)
  down <- make_track(rep(1000, 60), rep(0, 60), start = 1e5)
  expect_equal(stats_tendency(up)$balance, "rising")
  expect_equal(stats_tendency(down)$balance, "falling")
  expect_equal(stats_tendency(down)$streak, -60L)
  expect_equal(stats_tendency(make_track(rep(100, 5), rep(0, 5)))$balance, "unknown")
  # bets grow 100 -> 400
  bets <- make_track(c(rep(100, 50), rep(400, 50)), rep(0, 100))
  expect_equal(stats_tendency(bets)$bet, "increasing")
  expect_equal(stats_tendency(bets)$bet_change, 3)
  # loss chaser: doubles the bet after every loss, back to 100 after a win
  w <- numeric(0); x <- numeric(0); b <- 100
  set.seed(9)
  for (i in 1:200) { won <- runif(1) < 0.45; w <- c(w, b); x <- c(x, if (won) 2 * b else 0); b <- if (won) 100 else min(b * 2, 1600) }
  ch <- make_track(w, x)
  expect_gt(chase_ratio(ch$wager, ch$net), 2)
  expect_equal(stats_tendency(ch)$chase_label, "chasing")
  flat <- make_track(rep(100, 200), rep(c(0, 200), 100))
  expect_equal(chase_ratio(flat$wager, flat$net), 1)
  expect_true(is.na(chase_ratio(c(100, 100), c(-100, 0))))
})

test_that("category: favourite by wagered coins, stake class and style", {
  tk <- make_track(c(rep(100, 30), rep(5000, 10)), rep(0, 40), cat = c(rep("classic", 30), rep("blackjack", 10)))
  c0 <- stats_category(tk)
  expect_equal(c0$favourite, "blackjack")                          # 50,000 vs 3,000 coins
  expect_equal(sum(c0$share), 1)
  expect_equal(c0$style, "tables")
  expect_equal(stake_class(100), "Micro stakes")
  expect_equal(stake_class(2500), "Mid stakes")
  expect_equal(stake_class(1e6), "VIP stakes")
  expect_equal(stats_category(track_new())$style, "unknown")
  expect_true(is.na(stats_category(track_new())$favourite))
})

test_that("features need enough plays and stay in range", {
  expect_null(stats_features(make_track(rep(100, STAT_MIN_PLAYS - 1), rep(0, STAT_MIN_PLAYS - 1))))
  f <- stats_features(make_track(rep(1000, 60), rep(c(0, 2000), 30), cat = c("classic", "roulette"), gap = 6, risky = c(TRUE, FALSE)))
  expect_named(f, names(STAT_FEATURES))
  expect_equal(f[["bet"]], 3)
  expect_equal(f[["pace"]], 10)                                    # one play every 6 s
  expect_equal(f[["risk"]], 0.5)
  expect_equal(f[["table"]], 0.5)
  expect_equal(f[["escalation"]], 0)
})

test_that("kNN recovers the archetype of held-out synthetic players", {
  ref <- archetype_reference()
  expect_equal(nrow(ref), 60 * nrow(ARCHETYPES))
  expect_identical(archetype_reference(), ref)                     # deterministic & cached
  # leave-one-out on a sample of the reference set
  set.seed(1)
  idx <- sample(nrow(ref), 100)
  hits <- vapply(idx, function(i) knn_classify(unlist(ref[i, names(ARCHETYPE_SD)]), ref[-i, ])$label == ref$label[i], logical(1))
  expect_gt(mean(hits), 0.9)
  # archetype centres classify as themselves, with high confidence
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ARCHETYPES))) {
    k <- knn_classify(unlist(ARCHETYPES[i, names(ARCHETYPE_SD)]))
    expect_equal(k$label, ARCHETYPES$id[i])
    expect_gte(k$confidence, 0.75)
    expect_equal(sum(k$votes), 9)
  }
})

test_that("the reference set does not disturb the caller's random stream", {
  .stats_cache$ref <- NULL
  set.seed(42); a <- runif(3)
  set.seed(42); archetype_reference(); b <- runif(3)
  expect_equal(a, b)
})

test_that("realistic play patterns are classified sensibly", {
  set.seed(2)
  grinder <- make_track(rep(1000, 200), rbinom(200, 1, .3) * 3000, gap = 4)
  expect_equal(knn_classify(stats_features(grinder))$label, "grinder")
  shark <- make_track(rep(2500, 60), rbinom(60, 1, .48) * 5000, cat = c("blackjack", "poker", "roulette"), gap = 15)
  expect_equal(knn_classify(stats_features(shark))$label, "shark")
  roller <- make_track(rep(50000, 60), rbinom(60, 1, .3) * 150000, gap = 10)
  expect_equal(knn_classify(stats_features(roller))$label, "roller")
  casual <- make_track(rep(250, 40), rbinom(40, 1, .3) * 750, gap = 15)
  expect_equal(knn_classify(stats_features(casual))$label, "casual")
})

test_that("k-means finds the community clusters", {
  ref <- archetype_reference()
  set.seed(3)
  pick <- ref[ref$label %in% c("casual", "roller", "shark"), ]
  pick <- pick[sample(nrow(pick), 60), ]
  feats <- data.frame(player_id = sprintf("p%02d", 1:60), pick[names(ARCHETYPE_SD)])
  cl <- community_clusters(feats, k = 3)
  expect_length(cl$cluster, 60)
  expect_equal(sum(cl$size), 60)
  expect_setequal(cl$label, c("casual", "roller", "shark"))
  # clusters agree with the true groups (purity)
  purity <- sum(vapply(split(pick$label, cl$cluster), function(x) max(table(x)), 0)) / 60
  expect_gt(purity, 0.9)
  expect_null(community_clusters(feats[1:5, ]))                   # too few players
  expect_null(community_clusters(NULL))
  same <- feats[rep(1, 10), ]
  expect_null(community_clusters(same))                            # no structure to find
})

test_that("a track survives the JSON round trip of a saved profile", {
  tk <- make_track(rep(100, 30), rep(c(0, 250), 15), cat = c("myth", "roulette"), risky = TRUE)
  tk <- track_add_session(tk, 1.7e9, 600, 30, 1e6, 1e6 + 750)
  json <- jsonlite::toJSON(track_snapshot(tk), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA)
  back <- track_restore(jsonlite::fromJSON(json, simplifyVector = FALSE))
  for (k in c("t", "bal", "wager", "net")) expect_equal(back[[k]], tk[[k]])
  expect_equal(back$cat, tk$cat)
  expect_equal(back$wager_cat, tk$wager_cat)
  expect_equal(back$max_dd, tk$max_dd)
  expect_equal(back$online, 600)
  expect_equal(back$sessions[[1]]$plays, 30)
  expect_equal(stats_features(back), stats_features(tk))
  # garbage in -> a fresh track
  bad <- track_restore(list(bal = list(1, 2), t = list(1)))
  expect_length(bad$bal, 0)
  expect_equal(track_restore("nope")$n, 0)
})

test_that("the balance chart is an inline SVG with the drawdown marked", {
  expect_null(stats_balance_svg(1000))
  svg <- as.character(stats_balance_svg(c(1000, 1500, 900, 1400)))
  expect_match(svg, "^<svg")
  expect_match(svg, "sc-dd", fixed = TRUE)
  expect_match(svg, "max drawdown -600", fixed = TRUE)
  expect_false(grepl("sc-ddmark", as.character(stats_balance_svg(c(1, 2, 3))), fixed = TRUE))
})

test_that("the report combines everything", {
  tk <- make_track(rep(1000, 40), rep(c(0, 1500), 20))
  r <- stats_report(tk, coins = 5e5, session = list(t0 = now_secs() - 60))
  expect_equal(r$plays, 40)
  expect_equal(r$wagered, 40000)
  expect_gte(r$online, 60)
  expect_equal(r$cur_dd, tk$peak - 5e5)
  expect_false(is.null(r$class))
  expect_equal(r$need, 0)
  expect_equal(stats_report(track_new(), 1e6)$need, STAT_MIN_PLAYS)
})

contract <- function(store) {
  id <- "abcdef0123456789"
  expect_null(store$load_player(id))
  snap <- list(v = 1L, coins = 4242, level = 3L, avatar = "\U0001F981", album = list(c011 = 2))
  expect_true(isTRUE(store$save_player(id, snap, "pt_BR")))
  got <- store$load_player(id)
  expect_equal(got$coins, 4242)
  expect_equal(got$album$c011, 2)
  snap$coins <- 5000
  store$save_player(id, snap, "pt_BR")                   # upsert
  expect_equal(store$load_player(id)$coins, 5000)
  store$save_player("zzzz00001111", list(v = 1L, coins = 9e6, level = 9L, avatar = ""), "en")
  lb <- store$leaderboard(10L)
  expect_equal(lb$player_id[1], "zzzz00001111")
  expect_equal(nrow(lb), 2)
  store$log_play(id, "slots", "vegasstrip", 1000, 2500)
  store$log_play(id, "blackjack", "classic", 500, 0)
  tot <- store$player_totals(id)
  expect_equal(c(tot$plays, tot$wagered, tot$won), c(2, 1500, 2500))
  expect_null(store$load_jackpots())
  pots <- JACKPOT_SEEDS + c(1, 2, 3, 4)
  store$save_jackpots(pots)
  expect_equal(store$load_jackpots(), pots)
  expect_true(isTRUE(store$jackpot_won(id, "mini", 20000)))

  # names: unique, case-insensitive lookup; a taken name never breaks a save
  expect_null(store$find_player_by_name("Lucky Cat"))
  snap$name <- "Lucky Cat"
  expect_true(isTRUE(store$save_player(id, snap, "en", features = c(bet = 3, pace = 5, risk = .2, table = .1, escalation = 0))))
  expect_equal(store$find_player_by_name("lucky cat"), id)
  expect_equal(store$find_player_by_name("  LUCKY   CAT "), id)
  thief <- list(v = 1L, coins = 1, level = 1L, avatar = "", name = "LUCKY CAT")
  expect_true(isTRUE(store$save_player("thief0000000001", thief, "en")))
  expect_equal(store$find_player_by_name("Lucky Cat"), id)          # still the first owner
  expect_equal(store$load_player("thief0000000001")$coins, 1)        # ...but the profile was saved
  lb <- store$leaderboard(10L)
  expect_equal(lb$name[lb$player_id == id], "Lucky Cat")
  # features for the community clustering (kept when a save has none)
  store$save_player(id, snap, "en")
  f <- store$all_features(10L)
  expect_equal(f$player_id, id)
  expect_equal(f$pace, 5)
  # play log with balance / category, sessions
  expect_true(isTRUE(store$log_play(id, "poker", "jacks", 500, 0, balance = 9999, category = "poker")))
  expect_equal(store$player_totals(id)$plays, 3)
  expect_true(isTRUE(store$log_session(id, 1.7e9, 1.7e9 + 600, 600, 1e6, 1.1e6, 42)))
  ss <- store$player_sessions(id, 5L)
  expect_equal(nrow(ss), 1)
  expect_equal(ss$plays, 42)
  expect_equal(ss$end_balance, 1.1e6)
}

  DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE players (player_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, state TEXT NOT NULL, coins REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                       level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, avatar TEXT, lang TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE plays (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, player_id TEXT NOT NULL, ts TEXT NOT NULL,
                       family TEXT NOT NULL, game TEXT NOT NULL, wager REAL NOT NULL, win REAL NOT NULL)")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO players VALUES ('oldplayer0001', '{\"v\":1,\"coins\":777}', 777, 2, '', 'en', 'x', 'x')")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO plays (player_id, ts, family, game, wager, win) VALUES ('oldplayer0001', 'x', 'slots', 'giant', 100, 0)")
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA user_version = 1")
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

  store <- fc_storage("sqlite", path)
  expect_equal(store$load_player("oldplayer0001")$coins, 777)        # data kept
  con <- fc_db_shared(path)
  expect_equal(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA user_version")[[1]], FC_SCHEMA_VERSION)
  expect_true(all(c("name", "features") %in% DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA table_info(players)")$name))
  expect_true(all(c("balance", "category") %in% DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "PRAGMA table_info(plays)")$name))
  expect_true("sessions" %in% DBI::dbListTables(con))
  expect_equal(store$player_totals("oldplayer0001")$plays, 1)
  expect_true(isTRUE(store$save_player("oldplayer0001", list(v = 1L, coins = 800, level = 2L, name = "Old Timer"), "en")))
  expect_equal(store$find_player_by_name("old timer"), "oldplayer0001")
  fc_db_close_all()
  expect_equal(fc_storage("sqlite", path)$find_player_by_name("Old Timer"), "oldplayer0001")   # idempotent re-open
})

test_that("storage errors become warnings, not crashes", {
  skip_if_not_installed("RSQLite")
  not_a_dir <- tempfile(); writeLines("x", not_a_dir)      # a file where a folder should be
  on.exit(unlink(not_a_dir), add = TRUE)
  store <- fc_storage("sqlite", file.path(not_a_dir, "db", "fortuneCougar.sqlite"))
  expect_warning(res <- store$load_player("abcdef0123456789"), "storage")
  expect_null(res)
})

test_that("the browser backend stores nothing server side", {
  b <- fc_storage("browser")
  expect_false(b$server_side)
  expect_null(b$load_player("abcdef0123456789"))
})

test_that("player names are cleaned and validated", {
  expect_equal(fc_clean_name("  Lucky   Cougar "), "Lucky Cougar")
  expect_equal(fc_clean_name(NULL), "")
  expect_true(fc_valid_name("Jo"))
  expect_true(fc_valid_name("Jos\u00e9 Ma\u00f1a_2.0"))
  expect_false(fc_valid_name("J"))
  expect_false(fc_valid_name(strrep("a", 21)))
  expect_false(fc_valid_name("_underscore"))
  expect_false(fc_valid_name("<script>"))
  expect_false(fc_valid_name("robert'); DROP"))
  expect_false(fc_valid_name(NA_character_))
})

test_that("player ids are validated", {
  expect_true(fc_valid_player_id("3f2a9c1e-7b1d-4e0a-9f00-1234567890ab"))
  expect_false(fc_valid_player_id("x"))
  expect_false(fc_valid_player_id("robert'); DROP TABLE players;--"))
  expect_true(fc_valid_player_id(fc_new_player_id()))
})

test_that("linked jackpot pots are restored from storage", {
  linked_jackpots_reset()
  on.exit(linked_jackpots_reset(), add = TRUE)
  store <- fc_storage("memory")
  store$save_jackpots(JACKPOT_SEEDS * 2)
  pool <- linked_jackpots(store)
  expect_equal(shiny::isolate(pool$pots), JACKPOT_SEEDS * 2)
  linked_jackpots_save(JACKPOT_SEEDS * 3)
  expect_equal(store$load_jackpots(), JACKPOT_SEEDS * 3)
})

name: todo.Rmd
content:
# todo.md - House of Fun Clone Implementation Checklist

*Note: Playtika regularly cycles a rotating roster of over 400 slots. This checklist covers the core franchise engines, major documented Vegas/3D/Fairy Tale slots, all metagame side-features, and expanded table game engines required for a 1:1 clone.*

## Meta & Side Games
- [ ] **HoF Album (Like a Pro)** - Card collection mechanic to complete albums for massive coin payouts.
- [ ] **Wheel of Fun** - Daily/hourly login wheel for free coins and multiplier bonuses.
- [ ] **Star Market** - Trading system for duplicate cards to buy fantastic bonuses and exclusive avatars.
- [ ] **Lucky Cards Mini Game** - Triggered upon pulling specific cards for extra randomized prizes.
- [ ] **Monsterpedia Challenges** - Gamified leveling map linked to specific monster-themed slot releases.
- [ ] **Playtika Rewards System** - Cross-game loyalty point tracking and VIP tier progression.
- [ ] **Daily Dash / Exclusive Challenges** - Daily progressing mission passes with daily, weekly, and monthly rewards.

## Classic & Vegas Slots
- [ ] **Classic 777 Cash** - Traditional 3-reel stepper featuring high volatility, classic fruit symbols, and multiplier wilds.
- [ ] **Bank of Jackpots** - High-roller Vegas style 5-reel game with a 4-tier linked progressive jackpot.
- [ ] **Vegas Strip** - Neon-drenched 5-reel slot focusing on scatter pays and free spin retriggers.
- [ ] **Classic Ruby** - Retro aesthetic with stacked symbols and a nudge feature to complete paylines.
- [ ] **City of Queens** - Luxury-themed slot offering a pick-and-win bonus game alongside standard reels.
- [ ] **Rapid Fire Jackpot Engines** - Specialized fast-play slots where quick sequential spins increase jackpot odds.

## Mythological & Adventure Slots
- [ ] **Purrymid Prince** - Egyptian-themed 5-reel slot featuring expanding cat-pharaoh wilds and a tomb-raiding bonus round.
- [ ] **Stone Gold** - Medusa-themed game where winning symbols turn to stone and lock in place for respins.
- [ ] **Blackbeards' Riches** - Pirate adventure slot with cascading reels and a map-progression bonus game.
- [ ] **Giant's Treasure** - Jack and the Beanstalk inspired climbing mechanic where wilds grow vertically across the reels.
- [ ] **Cinderella** - Fairy Tale engine game featuring a midnight countdown mechanic that transforms standard symbols into carriage wilds.
- [ ] **Mighty Phoenix** - Asian-themed 243-ways-to-win slot featuring a hold-and-spin jackpot feature.
- [ ] **Dragon's Fury** - High-volatility Asian-themed slot featuring randomly triggered expanding dragon wilds that cover entire reels.
- [ ] **Mermaid's Pearl** - Underwater adventure with a collection mechanic; gather 100 pearls to trigger the Grand Jackpot spin.
- [ ] **Wild West Bounty** - Cowboy-themed slot with a dual-screen shooting gallery mini-game for instant coin prizes.

## Animal & Fantasy 3D Slots
- [ ] **3 Tigers** - High-variance animal slot where players choose their volatility level during the free spins feature.
- [ ] **Kitty Gems** - Cute feline theme with multiplying diamond wilds and frequent low-tier payouts.
- [ ] **Gummy King 2** - Candy-themed cascading reels slot with progressive multipliers on consecutive wins.
- [ ] **Frankenstein Rising** - Horror-themed slot with reviving wilds and a laboratory mini-game tied to the Monsterpedia.
- [ ] **Vile Vixens** - Monster-themed slot featuring sticky wilds that remain on the board for up to 3 subsequent spins.
- [ ] **Dark Jaguar** - Jungle night theme with mystery stacked symbols that reveal identical matching symbols after the spin.
- [ ] **Vampire's Kiss** - Gothic romance 3D slot featuring a "blood moon" respin mechanic and transferring wilds.

## Blackjack (Table Games Expansion)
- [ ] **Classic Blackjack** - Standard 6-deck Vegas rules, dealer stands on soft 17, double down on any two cards.
- [ ] **European Blackjack** - Dealer does not receive a hole card until the player finishes their hand; no peeking for blackjack.
- [ ] **Blackjack Switch** - Player plays two hands simultaneously and can switch the top cards between hands to optimize their odds.
- [ ] **Perfect Pairs Blackjack** - Classic rules with a lucrative side bet that pays out if the player's initial two cards form a pair (mixed, colored, or perfect).

## Video Poker (Table Games Expansion)
- [ ] **Jacks or Better** - The foundational video poker experience; payouts begin at a pair of Jacks.
- [ ] **Deuces Wild** - Fast-paced variant where all "2" cards act as wilds, substituting for any other card to build winning hands.
- [ ] **Bonus Poker** - Similar to Jacks or Better but offers premium bonus payouts for specific four-of-a-kind hands (like four Aces).
- [ ] **Joker Poker** - Played with a 53-card deck including one Joker that acts as a wild; requires Kings or Better to qualify for a win.

## Roulette (Table Games Expansion)
- [ ] **European Roulette** - Traditional single-zero (0) wheel offering a lower house edge and standard inside/outside betting.
- [ ] **American Roulette** - Features both a single zero (0) and double zero (00) wheel with an adjusted betting layout.
- [ ] **French Roulette** - Single-zero wheel featuring the "La Partage" rule, where players receive half their even-money bets back if the ball lands on zero.
- [ ] **Multi-Wheel Roulette** - Allows the player to place one set of bets that are active across up to 6 simultaneously spinning European roulette wheels.
